question:
**Select the option which means the same as the group of words given**.

Something which is considered to be very important.
solution:
The correct answer is **Cardinal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cardinal**: Serving as an essential component
 
• **Supplementary**: Functioning in a supporting capacity
 
• **Meagre**: Deficient in amount, quality or extent
 
• **Scanty**: Lacking in magnitude or quantity
 
• From the above given meaning of the option we can say that **cardinal **is the most appropriate choice of the answer.
 
• Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.
